scope: Canonical Language Book evidence objects; excludes the separate 19-record Package E/F/G decision queue.
principles: Review one evidence object at a time.
Source Verification and AI Review are independent decisions.
A word-record status never transfers to its child objects.
A linked experiment does not convert a hypothesis into a fact.

required_checks: The source is identifiable, dated/versioned when possible, and directly accessible or locally archived.
The exact claim supported by the source is recorded.
The claim the source does not support is recorded.
Conflicts, ambiguity and source-quality limitations remain visible.
A project page or author note is not treated as independent verification.

required_common_checks: Confirm the object's identity and do not review a different layer by proxy.
Confirm every cited source is relevant to this exact claim.
Distinguish observation, interpretation, historical assertion, hypothesis and experimental result.
Retain counterevidence and narrower alternative explanations.
Calibrate confidence to the evidence actually attached.
Record reviewer identifier, timestamp, rationale and cited object/source IDs.

primary_chinese_mapping: The record has exactly one primary Chinese mapping.
A proposed mapping is not described as standard translation unless lexical sources support it.
Phonetic resemblance is not used as historical etymology.
mapping_rationale_author_idea: The author's original reason is preserved accurately.
The rationale is labelled as author idea rather than external fact.
historical_etymology: Each link in the chain is supported by historical dictionary or scholarly evidence.
Intermediate forms are not silently skipped when the source distinguishes them.
Cross-language resemblance is excluded from the historical chain.
sound_consonant_symbol_hypothesis: The hypothesis is operational enough to be contradicted or tested.
Historical sound claims require regular correspondences across multiple forms and a plausible chronology.
A letter-name or pictorial origin does not by itself establish modern sound semantics.
other_author_note: Do not force classification when evidence is insufficient.
If classified, preserve the original note and record the new target object ID.
experimental_validation: Only an actually executed experiment may enter this layer.
The tested condition, result, status and hypothesis reference are explicit.
The conclusion does not extend beyond the preregistered condition.

reviewed_by_ai_requires: signed AI review metadata and rationale
promotion_gate.published_requires: A separate Package G publication gate and explicit human publisher approval.
